title: fix(app-shell): a write to a related child re-reads the record, so the header's rollups update in place (objectui#12244)
body:
Fixes #12244

## What was wrong

Every block of a record page draws from the ONE record `RecordDetailView` loads: the page header, the highlight strip, the details sections. That load re-ran on the client invalidation bus (`@object-ui/react` `data-invalidation`) only for a change to this record or this record's object, through `useDataInvalidation(objectName, pureRecordId)`.

A write to a child row in a related list reaches the bus under the CHILD's object name:

- a related-list row delete and the child form overlay's save go through `dataSource.delete` / `dataSource.update`; the adapter's MutationEvent reaches the bus through `useMutationInvalidationBridge` (mounted once in `AppContent`) as a change to the child object;
- a child row action posts `notifyRelatedChanged(child)`, an object-wide change to the child object.

Neither matched the parent, so the parent row was never read again. The related list refreshed, and the header kept the old total until a browser reload.

## Measured before the fix

- **Which reader draws the reported header.** HotCRM 4.0.1 (`objectstack-ai/hotcrm`, read-only clone at `0f84c9c`) declares no authored page for `crm_quote`; its only record page is `opportunity_detail.page.ts`. So QTE-0007 renders the synthesized default page. `crm_quote` declares `highlightFields: ['quote_number', 'name', 'crm_account', 'status', 'total_price']`. The synthesized page drops the title field and draws the rest in `record:highlights`, which hands `HeaderHighlight` the record context's `data`. That is `RecordDetailView`'s loaded row. The PM's mechanism assumption 4 (a separate header fetch) does not hold: the header draws through `RecordDetailView`'s record.
- **Where the rollup comes from.** `crm_quote.total_price` is a plain currency field. `quote_line_item.hook.ts` recomputes it on `afterInsert` / `afterUpdate` / `afterDelete` of `crm_quote_line_item` (master-detail `crm_quote`). It is not a `summary` field, so a fix keyed on summary-field declarations would not cover the reported reach. The fix keys on the relationship instead.
- **Red on `main` `7578323`**, the new test file: `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`. All three child-write cases fail at the same assertion, `expected 1 to be 2`: the parent was read once. In the delete case the fake backend had already received `delete(quote_line, l-1)` and recomputed the rollup.

## The fix (reader side, one seam)

`RecordDetailView` subscribes once to the bus for its derived related children (`childRelations` from `deriveRelatedLists`, the same set the page's related lists come from). A change to one of those objects bumps a second nonce in the existing record-load effect's dependency list. The SAME `findOne` re-runs in place:

- no remount: the header DOM node and the active tab survive (AGENTS.md #8);
- no client-side rollup: the header shows what the server returns for the parent;
- keyed by content: the child names are sorted and joined into a string, never the memo's identity (AGENTS.md #10);
- one parent read per change, however many lists are mounted. A `'*'` bumps both nonces from one dispatch, and React batches the two updates into one render, so the row is read once.

This follows the precedent `record:reference_rail` set for its own rows (objectui#12110 item 4): the writer declares what it wrote, and the reader knows what it depends on. A writer-side route (the related list posting a parent change) would not cover the form overlay's save. `AppContent` performs that save, and for an edit it knows only the child.

Fences held: no new export, prop, spec key or i18n key; `data-invalidation.ts` is unchanged. `subscribeDataChanges` and `dataChangeMatches` are already exported and are what the rail uses.

## Tests

New: `RecordDetailView.childWriteRefreshesParent-12244.test.tsx`. It renders the real page under the app route and the real `useMutationInvalidationBridge`. The fake backend computes the rollup itself, so the figure on screen can only come from a fresh read of the parent.

1. Row Delete through the related list UI (row-actions menu, Delete, confirm dialog): the parent is read again, the header shows 3,000 instead of 9,000, the header node is the same node, and the Related tab stays selected.
2. A child `update` through the dataSource (the form overlay's write): the parent is read again and the new total shows.
3. A child row action (object-wide child change): the parent is read again.
4. A write to an unrelated object: no parent read.
5. `'*'`, then a change to the parent itself: one read each, not two.

Ablation, through `ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, anchor hit 1, blob changed, restore proved by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

- Removing the nonce bump at `784b3dd`: `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`. The three child-write cases go red.
- Removing a record-scope guard the first draft had: `5 passed`. The guard was unpinned, since React batches the shared bump, so `e2e5356` deleted it rather than keep an unpinned branch.

Gates on the final head `277f43a` (after both merges), each through the shared verify lock unless it is a `check:*` script:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 1306 passed | 1 skipped (1307)`, `Tests 12585 passed | 9 skipped (12594)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test tsconfig lists the new file, by `--listFilesOnly`): exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (28 of 28 tasks).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 (1 changeset, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- eslint, narrowed to the two touched source files. The population is `**/*.{ts,tsx}` under `eslint.config.js`, which has no `parserOptions.project` (not type-aware) and no custom rule that reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Files linted: 2 (JSON output). Result: 0 errors. `RecordDetailView.tsx` has the same per-rule warning counts as on `main` (109 = 109), and the new test has 0 warnings.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure`. It needs a console production build, and this diff adds no module edge. The two new symbols come from `@object-ui/react`, which the file already imports. The workflow that runs it on CI owns it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Boundary: authored lists outside the derived set.** On an authored page, a `record:related_list` over a child whose FK declares `relatedList: false`, or one listed through an audit FK (`created_by` / `updated_by` / `owner_id`), is not in `childRelations`. A write to that child does not re-read the parent. Measured pull: `relatedList: false` appears 0 times in HotCRM's `src`. HotCRM's one authored page (`opportunity_detail.page.ts`) lists `crm_quote`, `crm_opportunity_line_item` and `crm_task` through FKs the derived set includes. Noted, not filed.
- **Observation, not reproduced.** `ObjectStackAdapter.emitMutation` drops in-flight `findOne` reads only for the WRITTEN resource. Suppose a parent read is still on the wire when a second child write lands. The refetch that write triggers can then join the earlier read and show the total from one write back, until the next change. This needs two child writes to complete within one parent read's round trip. It is a read-only inference from the coalescing code, with no reproduction. Carrier: none.
- **Cost.** Each child write costs one more parent read. A self-referencing object (for example an account's `parent_account`) re-reads the parent on any write to that object, because the bus's change names no parent.

## Overlap

objectui#12257 (card objectui#12242) and objectui#12259 landed on `main` while this was in flight. Both are merged in (merge commits, no rebase). objectui#12257's `RelatedList.tsx` hunk relays `currencyConfig` into a column's field meta. objectui#12259 touches the activity feed. Neither overlaps this change, and neither covers it.
